A <br> inside a fenced code block stays a real newline, not a split span

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<pre><code>A<br>B</code></pre>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
